name: Machine House (India) Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Machine House (India) Pvt. Ltd. is based in Nashik, India, and has a strong presence with a trained sales and design team and a dealer network across major industrial cities.
summary: Machine House (India) Pvt. Ltd. specializes in providing high-quality anti-vibration solutions, crucial for precision machining and measurement in semiconductor and photonics industries. They offer a range of vibration isolation products that help enhance precision processes.
